title: Step 4 - H2O Deep Learning: Making Predictions and Evaluating Model Accuracy

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome to this R tutorial.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到這堂 R 教學。

cues.en: So we just trained our artificial neural network on the training set and now time to make the predictions on the test set.
cues.zh: 剛才已用訓練集訓練人工神經網路，現在要對測試集進行預測。

cues.en: So lucky for us, we already have everything ready here thanks to our classification templates that we pasted in the first tutorial.
cues.zh: 幸好，第一堂課貼上的分類範本已經幫我們準備好所需內容。

cues.en: So actually this section predicts the test set results and this section makes the confusion matrix thanks to which we will obtain the accuracy
cues.zh: 這一段預測測試集結果，另一段建立混淆矩陣，藉此算出

cues.en: on the test set that is some accuracy on new observations on which our artificial neural network model wasn't trained.
cues.zh: 測試集準確率，也就是模型未曾拿來訓練的新觀測值上的準確率。

cues.en: So first, let's take care of this section and let's see what we need to change.
cues.zh: 先處理這一段，看看需要改什麼。

cues.en: So first of all, this first line gets the predicted probabilities thanks to this predict function.
cues.zh: 第一行透過 predict 函式取得預測機率。

cues.en: But that was the predict function used for built-in our packages.
cues.zh: 不過，那是一般 R 套件使用的 predict 函式。

cues.en: But here, since we are using the H2O package that is kind of special, There are actually some things that we need to change here but very few things.
cues.zh: 這裡用的是比較特別的 H2O 套件，所以要做一些修改，但改動很少。

cues.en: So first, as for all the functions we used with this H2O package, well you noticed that when we use a function we first take the H20 package, then a dot
cues.zh: 你應該注意到了，使用 H2O 套件中的函式時，都是先寫 h2o，再加上句點，

cues.en: and then the name of the function.
cues.zh: 然後寫函式名稱。

cues.en: Well, we need to do the same here for the predict function.
cues.zh: 這裡的 predict 函式也一樣。

cues.en: So here we just need to add H2O.predict.
cues.zh: 只要改成 h2o.predict。

cues.en: Okay, so that's the first thing we need to change.
cues.zh: 這是第一個要修改的地方。

cues.en: And then let's see, let's go inside the function.
cues.zh: 接著看看函式裡面。

cues.en: So the first argument is classifier.
cues.zh: 第一個引數是 classifier。

cues.en: Let's press here F1 to get some information about the predict function of the H2O model.
cues.zh: 在這裡按 F1，查看 H2O 模型 predict 函式的說明。

cues.en: So let's scroll down to have a look at the arguments and let's see what they are.
cues.zh: 往下捲動，看看有哪些引數。

cues.en: So as we can see, we have only two main arguments and then some additional arguments, but that we will not focus on.
cues.zh: 可以看到，只有兩個主要引數，還有一些額外引數，暫時不討論。

cues.en: Instead, we will focus on the two main arguments here which are the object and new data.
cues.zh: 我們專注在 object 和 newdata 這兩個主要引數。

cues.en: So the first thing we can see is that there is no type argument.
cues.zh: 首先可以看到，沒有 type 引數。

cues.en: So here simply we will remove this type equals response argument and input because we actually don't need it.
cues.zh: 所以移除 type = response，因為不需要它。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And now we are left with the two arguments we are required to input, that is, the object, which is our classifier here.
cues.zh: 這樣就剩下必填的兩個引數。object 是這裡的 classifier，

cues.en: That is the ANN model itself that we have just built on the training set.
cues.zh: 也就是剛才用訓練集建立的 ANN 模型本身。

cues.en: And then the second argument, new data.
cues.zh: 第二個引數是 newdata。

cues.en: And this new data argument is expecting of course, the observations of which it has to make the predictions.
cues.zh: newdata 當然需要填入要進行預測的觀測值。

cues.en: All right, so that's exactly our test set, and here we remove the dependent variable column thanks to this minus three here.
cues.zh: 也就是測試集。這裡用 -3 去除依變數所在的欄。

cues.en: But we need to replace this three because this number three here corresponds to the index of the dependent variable of the data set that we worked with in part three classification.
cues.zh: 不過必須更改這個 3，因為它對應的是第 3 部分分類單元資料集的依變數索引。

cues.en: And here of course, the index of our dependent variable is not 3, but is 11.
cues.zh: 目前依變數的索引當然不是 3，而是 11。

cues.en: Remember, we already replaced the index three here in this feature scaling part.
cues.zh: 記得，在特徵縮放這一段已經改過索引 3。

cues.en: So we replaced the 4 indexes, 3 that were here by 11.
cues.zh: 我們把原本四個索引 3 都改成了 11。

cues.en: And so here we need to do the same.
cues.zh: 這裡也要一樣處理。

cues.en: We will replace this 3 index here by index 11.
cues.zh: 把這裡的索引 3 改成 11。

cues.en: All right, so now this is taking the test set observations as new data.
cues.zh: 好，現在就會把測試集的觀測值當成新資料。

cues.en: That is, it will predict the probabilities that the dependent variable exited equals one for the observations in a test set.
cues.zh: 也就是對測試集中的觀測值，預測依變數 Exited 等於 1 的機率。

cues.en: And therefore, it will predict for each customer in the test set the probability that this customer leaves the bank.
cues.zh: 換句話說，會預測測試集裡每位客戶離開銀行的機率。

cues.en: And since we have the real results of whether the customers of the test set left or stayed in the bank, well we will compare our predictions to these real results, these actual results.
cues.zh: 我們也有測試集客戶實際離開或留在銀行的結果，因此會把預測與這些實際結果比較。

cues.en: And that's how we'll get the accuracy, by computing the number of correct predictions divided by the total number of observations in a test set, that is 2000.
cues.zh: 準確率就是正確預測數，除以測試集總觀測值數量，也就是 2,000。

cues.en: And then if we get a good accuracy, then maybe we'll get a good and powerful model.
cues.zh: 如果準確率夠好，或許就得到了一個有效而強大的模型。

cues.en: And if that's the case, we will give it to the bank on the plate and tell the bank, "Okay, now you can rank all your customers, all the customers in the bank by their probability to leave the bank.
cues.zh: 如果是這樣，就能把模型交給銀行，告訴他們：「現在可以依離開銀行的機率，替所有客戶排序。

cues.en: That is for each of your customers, you can predict with a good accuracy, and will be able to tell them precisely what this accuracy is.
cues.zh: 對每位客戶都能做出準確率不錯的預測，我們也能明確說明這個準確率。

cues.en: You'll be able to predict with a good accuracy the probability that the customer leaves the bank.
cues.zh: 你可以以不錯的準確率，預測客戶離開銀行的機率。

cues.en: And then you can add, therefore I can give you a ranking of all your customers ranked by their probability to leave the bank from the highest probability to the lowest probability.
cues.zh: 因此，我能提供一份所有客戶的排序，按離開銀行的機率由高到低排列。

cues.en: And therefore, you can do some customer segmentation and consider, for example the top 10% probabilities that the customers leave the bank.
cues.zh: 接著可以進行客戶分群，例如取離開銀行機率最高的前 10% 客戶。

cues.en: And in this segment, you can analyze deeper the factors that lead the customers to leave the bank by using some data mining techniques like for example doing a chi-square test
cues.zh: 在這個群體中，可以運用資料探勘技巧，進一步分析客戶離開的因素，例如卡方檢定，

cues.en: or applying the stats summary function on your independent variables to understand which independent variables have the most impact on the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 或對自變數使用統計摘要函式，了解哪些自變數對依變數影響最大。

cues.en: That is, which independent variable explains the most why customers are leaving.
cues.zh: 也就是哪個自變數最能解釋客戶為什麼離開。」

cues.en: Well, you know how to do that.
cues.zh: 你已經知道怎麼做了。

cues.en: That's exactly what we did in part two and three when we use this summary function to get the P values and statistical significance levels to see which independent variables
cues.zh: 這正是第 2、3 部分所做的：透過 summary 函式取得 p 值和統計顯著水準，看看哪些自變數

cues.en: are the most statistically significant and therefore explain the best, the dependent variable that is why customers are leaving.
cues.zh: 在統計上最顯著，因此最能解釋依變數，也就是客戶為什麼離開。

cues.en: So that's the purpose behind making these predictions on the test set.
cues.zh: 這就是對測試集進行預測的目的。

cues.en: It's just to get the accuracy on new observations to validate the model so that we can give this model to the bank.
cues.zh: 取得新觀測值上的準確率，驗證模型，然後就能把模型交給銀行。

cues.en: All right, so now let's make the predictions.
cues.zh: 好，現在來預測。

cues.en: So we are almost done here.
cues.zh: 這裡已經快完成了。

cues.en: We just need to add one more thing, which is again related to the fact that we are using the H2O package.
cues.zh: 只要再加一個東西，這同樣與使用 H2O 套件有關。

cues.en: And as you can see in this new data argument while this new data is of course the test set, but this test set is expected to be an H2O frame.
cues.zh: newdata 當然是測試集，不過這裡要求測試集是 H2OFrame。

cues.en: Right now it is a standard data frame, but our H2O predict function is expecting an H2O frame.
cues.zh: 目前它是一般 data frame，而 h2o.predict 預期的是 H2OFrame。

cues.en: So how can we convert this test set data frame into an H2O frame?
cues.zh: 那要怎麼把測試集的 data frame 轉成 H2OFrame？

cues.en: Well, by doing exactly the same as what we did to convert this training set data frame into this H2O frame,
cues.zh: 方法和先前把訓練集的 data frame 轉成 H2OFrame 完全相同，

cues.en: that is by applying on the test set the as.H2O function.
cues.zh: 也就是對測試集使用 as.h2o 函式。

cues.en: All right, so I'm putting the test set in the function like that, and here we go.
cues.zh: 把測試集放進函式裡，像這樣，就好了。

cues.en: Now, I think everything is ready.
cues.zh: 現在應該都準備好了。

cues.en: We are ready to make the predictions which so far will be the prediction of the probabilities that the class equals one.
cues.zh: 可以開始預測，目前預測的是類別等於 1 的機率，

cues.en: That is the probabilities that the customers leave the bank.
cues.zh: 也就是客戶離開銀行的機率。

cues.en: So let's select this and get the predicted probabilities.
cues.zh: 選取這一段，取得預測機率。

cues.en: And here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: We now have the pred vector containing all the predicted probabilities in the form of an environment.
cues.zh: 現在有了包含所有預測機率的 prob_pred 向量，目前是環境物件的形式。

cues.en: So that's good, but we can now have a look at these predicted probabilities yet.
cues.zh: 很好，不過還不能直接查看這些預測機率。

cues.en: We will need to convert it back into a standard vector.
cues.zh: 需要把它轉回一般向量。

cues.en: But before we do that, convert it into a vector, well, we need to apply this line as well which will, you know, transform the probabilities
cues.zh: 但在轉成向量之前，還要執行這一行，把機率

cues.en: into the predictions in the form one or zero.
cues.zh: 轉成 1 或 0 形式的預測。

cues.en: That is exactly the predictions of the dependent viable exited.
cues.zh: 也就是依變數 Exited 的預測值。

cues.en: And to do this, we're using this if else function.
cues.zh: 這裡使用 ifelse 函式。

cues.en: And basically what we do is we choose a threshold such that if the predicted probability is above the threshold, then we predict one.
cues.zh: 基本做法是選定門檻，預測機率高於門檻就預測為 1。

cues.en: And if the predicted probability is below the threshold, then we predict zero.
cues.zh: 預測機率低於門檻就預測為 0。

cues.en: So that's a natural threshold to take when we get our predictions in terms of probabilities.
cues.zh: 當預測結果是機率時，這是一個自然的門檻選擇。

cues.en: Know that it is not necessarily always 50%, 0.5.
cues.zh: 不過門檻不一定永遠是 50%，也就是 0.5。

cues.en: That's the case, for example, in medicine when we have to predict some sensitive informations, like for example predicting if a tumor is malignant.
cues.zh: 例如醫療領域，若要預測敏感資訊，像是腫瘤是否為惡性，

cues.en: Well, that's more sensitive, so in that case, we better be sure of our predictions and therefore we would choose a higher threshold like for example, 80%.
cues.zh: 這就比較敏感，我們會希望預測更有把握，因此可能選擇較高的門檻，例如 80%。

cues.en: But here we are predicting if a customer leaves the bank, so we are fine with the 50% threshold.
cues.zh: 不過這裡預測的是客戶是否離開銀行，用 50% 的門檻就可以。

cues.en: So that's okay.
cues.zh: 這樣沒問題。

cues.en: And by the way, there is a more simple way to get these predictions in the form 001 without using this if else function.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，不用 ifelse 也能更簡單地取得 0、1 形式的預測。

cues.en: It's by simply removing this one and zero here and removing this if else, and by using this.
cues.zh: 只要移除這裡的 1、0 和 ifelse，改用這個判斷式。

cues.en: Prop bread larger than 0.5 because this will return a Boolean which will be true if prop bread is larger than oh 0.5
cues.zh: prob_pred > 0.5 會傳回布林值；prob_pred 大於 0.5 時為 TRUE，

cues.en: and false if prop bread is below oh 0.5.
cues.zh: 小於 0.5 時為 FALSE。

cues.en: And white bread in the form of these Booleans, true and false will be accepted in this confusion matrix here.
cues.zh: 以 TRUE、FALSE 布林值呈現的 y_pred，也可以用在這裡的混淆矩陣中。

cues.en: So that's more simple.
cues.zh: 這樣更簡單。

cues.en: And now let's get this predictions in the form of Booleans.
cues.zh: 現在取得布林值形式的預測。

cues.en: All right, so I'm going to select this line and execute.
cues.zh: 選取這一行並執行。

cues.en: All right, so now we have our white bread in the form of Booleans but it is still an H2O object because it is the result in the first place of this H20 adopt predict function.
cues.zh: 現在 y_pred 已經是布林值，但仍是 H2O 物件，因為它最初來自 h2o.predict 函式。

cues.en: So it is still an H20 object, and therefore, now what we have to do is to convert this H20 object back into a vector because this table function here
cues.zh: 既然它仍是 H2O 物件，就必須把它轉回向量，因為這裡的 table 函式

cues.en: will only accept a vector, a standard vector and of course will never accept this H20 object.
cues.zh: 只接受一般向量，不接受這個 H2O 物件。

cues.en: So let's convert it back into a vector.
cues.zh: 所以把它轉回向量。

cues.en: And that's actually real simple.
cues.zh: 方法非常簡單。

cues.en: It's actually kind of the same as converting a data frame into an H20 frame.
cues.zh: 有點像把 data frame 轉成 H2OFrame，

cues.en: But instead of using H20 here, we will use vector.
cues.zh: 不過這裡不使用 h2o，而是 vector。

cues.en: So here we simply need to type white bread equals as .vector and in parenthesis of course, white bread.
cues.zh: 只要輸入 y_pred = as.vector(y_pred)。

cues.en: All right, so let's check it out.
cues.zh: 好，試試看。

cues.en: I'm going to select this line and execute.
cues.zh: 選取這一行並執行。

cues.en: And now as you can see, white bread became this vector of integers containing 2000 elements and that's the standard vector of R we were used to working with.
cues.zh: 如你所見，y_pred 已變成包含 2,000 個元素的整數向量，就是我們熟悉的 R 一般向量。

cues.en: So we can actually have a look at the predictions of the tested observations by typing here in the console, white bread.
cues.zh: 現在可以在主控台輸入 y_pred，查看測試集觀測值的預測。

cues.en: Here we go, that's all the predictions of the tested observations, 2000 predictions.
cues.zh: 這些就是測試觀測值的全部預測，共 2,000 筆。

cues.en: So here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: According to the model, the first customer stayed in the bank, the second customer stayed in the bank, the third customer left the bank, the fourth one stayed, the fifth one stayed, et cetera.
cues.zh: 根據模型，第一位客戶留在銀行、第二位也留下、第三位離開、第四位留下、第五位留下，依此類推。

cues.en: So if you want, you can actually compare these predictions with the real results that are in the last column of test set, this column here.
cues.zh: 如果願意，可以把這些預測與 test_set 最後一欄，也就是這一欄的實際結果比較。

cues.en: So for example, 001, 000 are the real outcomes of the fifth first customers.
cues.zh: 例如 0、0、1、0、0、0，是最前面幾位客戶的實際結果。

cues.en: And if we compare that with the predictions while we see that the predictions are quite correct because here we get as well, 001, 000.
cues.zh: 與預測比較，可以看到預測相當正確，這裡也得到 0、0、1、0、0、0。

cues.en: So the five first predictions are correct.
cues.zh: 所以前五筆預測都是正確的。

cues.en: So that smells pretty good for our accuracy that we're about to compute because when we look at the first observations, we can only see correct predictions.
cues.zh: 這對接下來要計算的準確率來說是個好兆頭，因為目前看到的前幾筆觀測值都預測正確。

cues.en: So now actually I can't wait to see the accuracy.
cues.zh: 我已經迫不及待想看準確率了。

cues.en: So let's compute it right now.
cues.zh: 現在就來計算。

cues.en: We will start by making the confusion matrix.
cues.zh: 先建立混淆矩陣。

cues.en: And of course here we need to replace this index three here by 11 because this corresponds to the index of the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 這裡當然也要把索引 3 改成 11，因為它對應依變數的索引。

cues.en: And so now we are ready to make this confusion matrix.
cues.zh: 現在可以建立混淆矩陣了。

cues.en: So I'm going to select this line and execute.
cues.zh: 選取這一行並執行。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: Confusion matrix created.
cues.zh: 混淆矩陣已建立。

cues.en: So now let's have a look.
cues.zh: 來看看。

cues.en: I'm going to type CM here in the console and press enter.
cues.zh: 在主控台輸入 cm，再按 Enter。

cues.en: That's our confusion matrix.
cues.zh: 這就是混淆矩陣。

cues.en: We can see a lot of correct predictions, so that's good.
cues.zh: 可以看到很多正確預測，很好。

cues.en: 1,536 correct predictions of customers who stayed in the bank and 195 correct predictions of customers
cues.zh: 正確預測留在銀行的客戶有 1,536 位，正確預測

cues.en: who left the bank.
cues.zh: 離開銀行的客戶有 195 位。

cues.en: And then we have 212 plus 57 incorrect predictions of customers who either left or stayed in the bank.
cues.zh: 另外有 212 加 57 筆錯誤預測，這些客戶可能離開或留在銀行。

cues.en: So this looks pretty good.
cues.zh: 看起來相當不錯。

cues.en: And now let's not wait anymore.
cues.zh: 現在別再等了。

cues.en: Let's compute the accuracy.
cues.zh: 來計算準確率。

cues.en: So the accuracy is the total number of correct predictions, that is 105,036 plus 195 divided by the total number
cues.zh: 準確率就是正確預測總數，也就是 1,536 加 195，再除以

cues.en: of observations in a test set, that is the total number of predictions actually, which is 2000.
cues.zh: 測試集的總觀測值數量，也就是預測總數 2,000。

cues.en: All right, so let's check it out.
cues.zh: 好，來看看結果。

cues.en: Let's see if we can offer this model to the bank.
cues.zh: 看看能不能把這個模型交給銀行。

cues.en: Let's see if we'll get the bonus.
cues.zh: 看看能不能拿到獎金。

cues.en: Let's find out about this accuracy on three, three, two, one, go.
cues.zh: 一起揭曉準確率，三、三、二、一，開始。

cues.en: 86.5%, that's actually not bad at all.
cues.zh: 86.5%，其實相當不錯。

cues.en: 86.5%, well, let's say 87.
87% means that on 100 observations, 87 predictions should be correct.
cues.zh: 87% 表示每 100 筆觀測值，應該有 87 筆預測正確。

cues.en: So this is pretty good.
cues.zh: 這相當不錯。

cues.en: And besides, we haven't done any parameter tuning and you will see that by doing some parameter tuning using some techniques like K-fold cross-validation, well, we can get an even better accuracy score.
cues.zh: 而且還沒做參數調校。你會看到，使用 K 折交叉驗證等技巧進行調校，還能得到更好的準確率。

cues.en: No worries, we will do that in part 10.
cues.zh: 別擔心，第 10 部分就會做。

cues.en: You can actually already practice to improve this accuracy score.
cues.zh: 你現在也可以先練習，嘗試提高這個準確率。

cues.en: And please let me know if you get an awesome one.
cues.zh: 如果得到很棒的結果，請告訴我。

cues.en: And now just one last thing, since we were connected to this H2O instance, it's better to disconnect from it now.
cues.zh: 最後還有一件事：既然剛才連線到 H2O 執行個體，現在最好中斷連線。

cues.en: And to do this, we only need to apply a last function of H2O, which is the H2O.shutdown.
cues.zh: 只要再使用一個 H2O 函式：h2o.shutdown。

cues.en: Here it is, with no arguments inside, you just need to select this and this will disconnect you from the server.
cues.zh: 就是這個，不填引數，選取並執行，就會中斷與伺服器的連線。

cues.en: So let's execute.
cues.zh: 現在執行。

cues.en: (mouse clicking) Are you sure you want to shut down the H2O instance running at this address?
cues.zh: （點擊滑鼠）確定要關閉在這個位址執行的 H2O 執行個體嗎？

cues.en: Then you just need to type here capital Y and then enter, and now we are disconnected.
cues.zh: 在這裡輸入大寫 Y，再按 Enter，就中斷連線了。

cues.en: True means yes, we did disconnect.
cues.zh: TRUE 表示是的，我們已中斷連線。

cues.en: So congratulations, you have built your first artificial neural network on R using the H2O package.
cues.zh: 恭喜，你已使用 H2O 套件，在 R 建立第一個人工神經網路。

cues.en: I was very happy to build this first deep learning model with you.
cues.zh: 很高興能與你一起建立第一個深度學習模型。

cues.en: And we are getting to the end of this section.
cues.zh: 這個章節也即將結束。

cues.en: Next section will be about convolutional neural networks, another branch of machine learning specialized for computer vision because it will consider spatial structure in the data exactly as it is the case
cues.zh: 下一章介紹卷積神經網路，這是專門處理電腦視覺的另一個機器學習分支，會考量資料的空間結構，例如

cues.en: for images where the position of the pixels matters.
cues.zh: 影像中的像素位置就很重要。

cues.en: So we will see that in the next section.
cues.zh: 下一章就會介紹。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受機器學習的樂趣。
